statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope
The patient has transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The procedure is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or embolic sources
The diagnosis codes are G45.9, I34.0, and R55
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits protocols
